name: TransposeTensor
description: Transpose a tensor by reordering its dimensions to align iteration and memory access order, improving cache utilization and vectorization efficiency.

parameters.name: tensor_operand
parameters.description: The operand name or index of the tensor to transpose (e.g., 'arg0', 'arg1', or an integer index into function operands).

parameters.name: permutation
parameters.description: A list of integers specifying the new dimension order. For example, [1, 0] transposes a 2D matrix, [2, 0, 1, 3] reorders 4D tensor dimensions.

parameters.name: operation_tag
parameters.description: A tag to mark the target operation for transformation. Defaults to 'linalg_op'.
